## The lost plants of Galiano Island

This gallery shows `<span class="galiano-lost-count">@{count}</span>`{=html} native species once reported for Galiano Island, which have not been seen in recent decades. Some may be lost *to us*—overlooked, forgotten, or waiting to be rediscovered. Others may be lost *because of us*, through impacts like habitat change or the introduction of invasive species.

<span class="galiano-callout">Pick a plant from the gallery</span> to see where and when it was last found, then join local naturalists and community members on a search for the
[Biodiversity Galiano Island](https://www.inaturalist.org/projects/biodiversity-galiano-island)
project on iNaturalist.

Herbarium collections at the Royal BC Museum and UBC, and Harvey Janszen’s (2003) *Outer Gulf Islands Vascular Plant
Checklist*, provide the historical baseline for this atlas. Harvey passed away in 2021, and a community of naturalists
has since carried his work forward through [Biodiversity Galiano](https://www.inaturalist.org/projects/biodiversity-galiano-island);
this atlas is a testament to that continuing legacy.
